name: s101-conventional-commit-blocks-heredoc-badmsg

tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
WIP stuff

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

notes: Claude Code writes commit messages as -m "$(cat <<'EOF' … EOF)". The hook only read one-line quoted messages, so a heredoc message was never checked (exit 0). The subject is the heredoc's first non-empty line.
